preconditions.description: The ratio string must contain exactly one colon.

preconditions.expression: all(char.isdigit() or char == ':' for char in ratio)
preconditions.description: The ratio string must contain only digits and one colon.
The width must be a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly one 'x' character.

postconditions.expression: all(char.isdigit() or char == 'x' for char in output)
postconditions.description: The output must contain only digits and one 'x' character.
The width part of the output must match the given width.
The height part of the output must be calculated correctly based on the given width and aspect ratio.
